digest.greeting: Good evening, Jean. Today closed with one project formally wrapped up, while the main carry-forward pressure remains around ownership, launch readiness, and vendor risk. Tomorrow is a dense leadership day with a noon calendar conflict to resolve.

items.label: Closed Project TRACE
items.detail: The formal project-closure thread confirmed that Project TRACE was closed today.

items.label: Consolidate the incident-trigger owner map
items.detail: Bucket-owner submissions were due today. Combine each trigger, notification owner, and communication path into one operating map, and follow up on any missing response.

items.label: Set the FirstFire and AWS decision path
items.detail: The September 15 data-usage date remains at risk. Josh confirmed that current costs are visible in AWS Billing and Cost Management and that no training is needed; confirm the remaining funding approval, sign-offs, and any cost exposure before changing the engagement.

items.label: Date the VAWA Post-21 production launch
items.detail: Acceptance criteria and admin notes changed today, and Nadia asked Jessie to confirm any intake-process impact. Resolve the dependent-visibility question, name the final UAT approver, and publish the launch date.

items.label: Close the Re-Open Cases SOP and handoff path
items.detail: Confirm the feedback date from Leo, settle the remaining contractual and financial questions, and set the handoff date so Gustavo can exit the project cleanly.

items.label: Set the Security Technology Launch path
items.detail: Confirm the Workplace Services and IT scoping group, sponsor path, first milestone, and Salt Lake City deployment sequence needed before the end of September.

items.label: Terminar Hoja de Jorge
items.detail: Finish the sheet and carry forward any open inputs that did not close during today's Compliance Portfolio Review and leadership meetings.

items.label: CSC Portfolio initial review was cancelled
items.detail: Outlook sent an explicit cancellation for today's CSC Portfolio initial review.

items.label: Amazon Connect production number capacity was approved
items.detail: Josh confirmed approval for 1,600 production numbers. The team can choose the numbers, with a preference to avoid the 380 and 614 area codes.

items.label: 10:00 AM-noon - Legal, Thiago, and Astrid
items.detail: Legal Change Management starts at 10:00 AM, followed by Thiago at 10:30 AM and Astrid at 11:30 AM. Carry forward any ownership questions that did not close today.

items.label: Noon-5:00 PM - Resolve the conflict before the leadership stack
items.detail: The Legal repository walkthrough overlaps blocked space at noon. Danny's quarterly skip-level begins at 1:30 PM, followed by the EPMO team meeting on the new IT delivery process, focus time, Laura, CoE, and Sara.
